name: Reaper: can equip thrown weapons (#9303)
contract: The Reaper already learns Throw 2764 at creation, but had no Thrown proficiency (2567, skill 176), so thrown weapons could not be equipped. A Reaper knows Thrown, equips a thrown weapon in the ranged slot, and an existing Reaper without it gets it back on login.

steps.label: a Reaper knows the Thrown proficiency
the thrown weapon is in the ranged slot
